goal: Joint six-field semantic adaptation of original Romanian and Ukrainian encoders.

training.groups: Equal source/class sampling across formal, conversational, authored augmentation.

selection: Development at initial, halfway and final steps; independent and training-fitted pair couplings; unchanged 99% recall / 5% false-review gates, then worst and total false reviews, field loss, earlier step and independent tie break.
numerical_margin: Choose a gap with at least 1e-4 margin without discarding required positive decisions; fallback threshold zero remains subject to false-review gate.
evaluation: Persist selection before calibration; actual installed CPU full development/calibration replay; reserved predictions only if both languages qualify.
design_evidence: Prior studies 43, 47 and 51 development and aggregate calibration failures informed this new training design. Calibration is regression evidence, not a fresh blind test.
synthetic_language_review: New compositions authored programmatically, not independently reviewed; not real child messages.
